files.conclusion: Keep original multiline selection, line building, paste, scroll/timer scheduling and paint order C. Native system-timer leaves already B under P42. Remaining task context, callbacks and mapped native-return/publication are S13. FillWindow native API is B, while the F wrapper around it owns current native-call scope and CTLCOLOR return handling.

Keep original single-line edit and hide/BeginPaint/EndPaint/show ordering C. Borrowed system-brush storage/resource provider moved B unchanged. Other mapped window/caret/native returns belong to shared S13 boundary, not an entire-file move.

migration.identity: Entire implementation unchanged except include spelling and newline normalization. Native borrowed system brushes and one owned gray brush retain original process lifetime and shared INIT_ONCE. Failure rollback and LastError preservation unchanged.
migration.declarations: Original TabTextOut declaration stays F drawing header; B header contains only native resources, fixed palette extent and readiness. No C layout or original drawing algorithm moved into B.

mechanisms.multiline: C MLMouseMotion chooses scroll period, sets timer with NULL callback, acquires capture, and cancels timer before ReleaseCapture. C MLEditWndProc chooses Begin/EndPaint based on supplied DC. Host wrappers preserve native-call context; shared S13 analysis must retain ordering.
mechanisms.singleline: C SLDrawLine consumes SYSHBR(HIGHLIGHT); actual storage now B, also serving original drawing consumers. SLEditWndProc hides caret outside BeginPaint and restores after EndPaint; this policy remains C.
mechanisms.capture: Mapped SetCapture publishes current capture after native return, ReleaseCapture identifies prior capture at entry. Current wrappers are not SDK-only leaves; final minimality remains shared S13 work.
